text: Header button toggles the agents' Stop continuation hook (same switch as the enable-hook / disable-hook prompts)

status.comment: Header shows 'Hook on/off' when the hook is installed; click toggles the per-clone git flag via system.setContinueHook. continue-hook moved to shared (used by MCP and backend). Verified live: off -> on round trip, shared tests 3/3, pnpm check 25/25. Left ON for Felix to switch off.
